name: Stars
overview: Scripture reveals that stars are part of God's created order, fashioned alongside the sun and moon to govern the night (Genesis 1:16). They serve as a testimony to His promise, as God invited Abraham to count the stars as a symbol of his countless descendants (Genesis 15:5). While the stars are created by God, the Bible warns against worshiping them, emphasizing that such idolatry is forbidden and was condemned in Israel's history (Deuteronomy 4:19; 2 Kings 17:16; 2 Kings 21:3). Additionally, stars carry figurative significance, such as the prophetic Star that will arise from Jacob, pointing to Christ’s coming (Numbers 24:17).
